g.title: mic_harness
g.text: VERA Mic Harness — Filtered Power, Shielded Signal

g.title: gnd_local
g.text: All amp-side returns tie here ONLY

g.title: rules
g.text: • Amp-side ground: I²C-header GND pin only. ALL caps + MAX GND tie here.
• Receiver-side ground: 3.5 mm TRS sleeve only. Twisted-pair return + foil drain go here.
• Copper foil shield FLOATS at the amp end. Soldered only to the TRS sleeve via drain wire.
• The two ground points are connected through the Pi's internal GND plane (via USB ground of
CM108 ↔ Pi USB shell ↔ I²C-header GND). This forms ONE long ground path, not a loop.
• Mount C1/C2/C3 within 5 mm of MAX4466 VDD pin. Lead length kills HF filtering.
• Ferrite + 10 Ω + caps form a π-filter to remove Pi-rail switching ripple.
• R_lp + C_lp (1 kΩ + 4.7 nF C0G) cut everything above 34 kHz → blocks RF.
• Twist signal and return ≥6 turns/inch for common-mode rejection.
• Helical-wrap copper foil; ≥ 50 % overlap per turn.
• Keep harness ≥ 25 mm away from servo PWM, fan PWM, USB and AC wires.
• If crossing any of those wires is unavoidable, cross at 90°.
